definitions.gloss: fake smile; forced smile; put-on laugh
definitions.explanation: a smile or laugh that is not genuine, often used socially or to hide true feelings

examples.japanese: {作|つく}り{笑|わら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To put on a fake smile.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{作|つく}り{笑|わら}いだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I can tell that smile is fake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本心|ほんしん}→本心：12864_honshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}して→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧{作|つく}り{笑|わら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{乗|の}り{切|き}った→乗り切る：11410_norikiru⟧。
examples.english: I hid my true feelings and got through it with a fake smile.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make, create) + ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧ (smile, laugh)
Literally "manufactured smile."

USAGE:
Can be used neutrally (social necessity) or negatively (insincerity). Context determines:
- Neutral: Smiling professionally or to be polite
- Negative: Being fake or deceptive

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {作|つく}り{笑|わら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to fake a smile
- {作|つく}り{笑|わら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浮|う}かべる→浮かべる：13314_ukaberu⟧ - to wear a fake smile
- {作|つく}り{笑|わら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{誤魔化|ごまか}す→誤魔化す：14212_gomakasu⟧ - to cover up with a fake smile
